title: Yul-Gok

symbol.name: Yul-Gok
symbol.meaning: The scholar Yi I · ITF pattern 5 of 24

note.p: Yul-Gok is the pen name of the philosopher and scholar Yi I (1536–1584), called the Confucius of Korea. The 38 movements stand for his birthplace on the 38th parallel, and the diagram 士 means scholar. You start in the middle of the short A–B line facing D: sitting-stance punches to each side, blocks, kicks and double punches out along the diagonals AD and BD, palm hooking blocks and punches down the stem, a side kick and elbow strike at the D end and again back toward C, twin knife-hand blocks and fingertip thrusts to E and F, high blocks and punches up toward C, a jump into X-stance, and two double forearm blocks to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (38 movements, one technique each; fast and connecting motions are numbered separately). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; AD and BD are the diagonals between them; E and F are the ends of the long line. Finish by bringing the left foot back to parallel ready stance.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in parallel ready stance: feet parallel and one shoulder-width apart, fists in front of the belt.
Move the left foot to B into a sitting stance facing D, extending the left fist straight out toward D at shoulder height.
In the same stance, right middle punch toward D.
Left middle punch toward D, fast after 2.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to A into a sitting stance facing D, extending the right fist toward D.
In the same stance, left middle punch toward D.
Right middle punch toward D, fast after 5.
Move the right foot toward AD into a right walking stance facing AD. Right inner forearm middle side block.
Left low front snap kick toward AD, the hands held where they were.
Set the left foot down toward AD into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
In the same stance, right middle punch, fast after 9.
Move the left foot toward BD into a left walking stance facing BD. Left inner forearm middle side block.
Right low front snap kick toward BD, the hands held where they were.
Set the right foot down toward BD into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
In the same stance, left middle punch, fast after 13.
Pivot on the left foot to face D in a right walking stance. Right palm middle hooking block.
In the same stance, left palm middle hooking block.
Right middle punch, flowing straight on from the two hooking blocks.
Step the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance. Left palm middle hooking block.
In the same stance, right palm middle hooking block.
Left middle punch, flowing straight on from the two hooking blocks.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
Turn the head to face D and draw up into a right bending ready stance A, side-on to D: standing on the bent right leg, the left foot lifted beside the knee.
Left middle side piercing kick toward D.
Set the left foot down toward D into a left walking stance and strike the open left palm with the right front elbow, with a kihap.
Turn the head to face C and draw up into a left bending ready stance A, side-on to C: standing on the bent left leg, the right foot lifted beside the knee.
Right middle side piercing kick toward C.
Set the right foot down toward C into a right walking stance and strike the open right palm with the left front elbow, with a kihap.
Turn left: move the left foot to E into a right L-stance facing E (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Twin knife-hand block.
Step the right foot forward toward E into a right walking stance. Right straight fingertip middle thrust.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to F into a left L-stance facing F (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Twin knife-hand block.
Step the left foot forward toward F into a left walking stance. Left straight fingertip middle thrust.
Turn left: move the left foot to C into a left walking stance facing C. Left outer forearm high side block.
In the same stance, right middle punch.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a right walking stance. Right outer forearm high side block.
In the same stance, left middle punch.
Jump forward toward C, landing in a left X-stance with the body turned to face B. Left back fist high side strike to C, with a kihap.
Move the right foot to A into a right walking stance facing A. Right double forearm high block, the left fist bracing the right arm.
Bring the right foot to the left foot, then move the left foot to B into a left walking stance facing B. Left double forearm high block, the right fist bracing the left arm.
